description: Removed `AsyncStandardRegionalEndpointsResolver` and its `smithy_aws_core.aio.endpoints` module, along with `smithy_aws_core.endpoints.RegionalEndpointConfig` and `REGIONAL_ENDPOINT_CONFIG`. Generated AWS clients now resolve endpoints from the service's endpoint rules with `smithy_core.endpoints.BddEndpointResolver` and `smithy_aws_core.endpoints.AWS_RULES_EXTENSION`.
